info.title: API.SH: Wikipedia
info.description: The Wikipedia API from API.SH: public Wikipedia data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Article titles that start with what was typed, in the site's suggestion order: title, page id, short description, link and thumbnail, plus any redirects that were followed.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wikipedia-autocomplete

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The start of a title.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language edition (default en), e.g. de, fr, ja.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Suggestions (default 10, max 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

suggestions.title: Albert Einstein College of Medicine
suggestions.description: Private medical school in New York City

get.description:
The pages, subcategories and files in a category, alphabetically or by when they were added: title, page id, namespace, type, date added, sort prefix and link, with the category's totals. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wikipedia-category

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Category name (Physicists or Category:Physicists) or its link.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language edition (default en), e.g. de, fr, ja.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Comma-separated: page, subcat, file (default all three).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: sortkey = alphabetical (default), timestamp = when added.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: asc (default) or desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Members per page (default 100, max 500).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` back to get the next page; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

members.title: List of Nobel laureates in Physics

get.description:
One Wikipedia article in any language edition: title, short description, lead summary (plain text), Wikidata id, main image and thumbnail, coordinates, infobox type and key/values (cleaned text), section outline, categories, up to 500 linked articles, image files, language versions with URLs, last edit time and size. Redirects are followed (`redirected_from`). `last_edited` is the time of the latest revision; `page_views` has the daily views of the last 60 days with their total and daily average. `include=text` adds `text`, the whole article as plain text with `== Section ==` headings.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wikipedia-page

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Article title (spaces or underscores). Use `title` or `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Wikipedia article URL; its language wins over `lang`.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language edition code (default en), e.g. de, fr, es, ja.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `text`: also return the full article text (costs extra).

parameters.name: parts
parameters.description: Return only these parts of the page, comma-separated (title, page_id, lang and url always come back): `summary`, `ids`, `images`, `coordinates`, `page_views`, `text`, `infobox`, `sections`, `categories`, `links`, `languages`, `raw`. Default: everything except `text`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every link of one kind for an article: the articles it links to, its categories (with hidden flag, sort key and date added), external links, the articles that link to it (backlinks), the templates it uses or the files it shows. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wikipedia-page-links

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Article title or link (https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tour_Eiffel; the link's language wins).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language edition (default en), e.g. de, fr, ja.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: links (default), categories, external, backlinks, templates or images.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: links/backlinks: comma-separated namespace numbers (default 0 = articles).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (default 500, max 500).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` back to get the next page; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An article's edit history: revision id, parent id, time, editor (name, id, anonymous flag), minor flag, edit summary, size and size change, tags, checksum, and links to the revision and its diff. Filter by date range or editor. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wikipedia-page-revisions

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Article title or link (https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tour_Eiffel; the link's language wins).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language edition (default en), e.g. de, fr, ja.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: older = newest first (default), newer = oldest first.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start from this date or time (with dir=older: the newest edit to show).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Stop at this date or time.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Only edits by this user.

parameters.name: exclude_user
parameters.description: Leave out edits by this user.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Revisions per page (default 50, max 500).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` back to get the next page; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Daily or monthly views of an article over a date range (default the last 30 days), with the total and average; or, with `top=1`, the most viewed articles of a day or month (rank, title, views, link). Data is ready about a day later.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wikipedia-pageviews

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Article title or link (not needed with top=1).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language edition (default en), e.g. de, fr, ja.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD (default 30 days ago).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (default yesterday).

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: daily (default) or monthly.

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: Which platform (default all-access).

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: Who viewed (default user = people).

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: 1 = the most viewed articles instead of one title.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: With top=1: a day (YYYY-MM-DD) or month (YYYY-MM); default two days ago.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: With top=1: articles (default 100, max 1000).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Full-text search of one Wikipedia language edition: title, URL, snippet, size, word count and last edit time per article, the total hit count and a spelling suggestion. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wikipedia-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text (Wikipedia search syntax such as intitle: and incategory: works).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language edition code (default en).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1-50 (default 20).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pass `next_offset` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
